notes.title: Announcing the release of [ Witch Spring 3 Re:Fine EXTRA CONTENTS ]
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the release of Witch Spring 3 Re:Fine EXTRA CONTENTS on the steamstore.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1753550/Witch_Spring_3_ReFine_EXTRA_CONTENTS/

In addition to the game's 30-track soundtrack, there is an 80-page art book with character sketches, a history of the game world and messages from the Japanese voice cast.

This product is a digital version of the artbook and soundtrack CD included in the PC package version released for the Japanese market and contains the same content.

The content is identical and all content is in Japanese.
